earnings.title: Republic Services, Inc. Reports
highlights: Reported Earnings Per Share of $1.93 and Adjusted Earnings Per Share of $1.94

(NYSE: RSG) today reported net income of $592 million, or $1.93 per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026, versus $550 million, or $1.76 per diluted share, for the comparable 2025 period.

Excluding certain expenses and other items, on an adjusted basis, net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was $595 million, or $1.94 per diluted share, versus $594 million, or $1.90 per diluted share, for the comparable 2025 period.

Total revenue growth of 8.2 percent includes 4.8 percent organic growth from our recycling and waste business, 2.1 percent growth from our environmental solutions business, and 1.3 percent growth from acquisitions.
Generated Year-to-Date Cash Flow from Operations of $3.52 Billion and Adjusted Free Cash Flow of $2.28 Billion

quotes.text: We delivered strong third quarter results that underscored the resilience of our business model and the effectiveness of our strategy.
quotes.by: Jon Vander Ark, president and chief executive officer

outlook: Revenue: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $17.425 billion to $17.475 billion
Adjusted EBITDA: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $5.550 billion to $5.575 billion
Adjusted Free Cash Flow: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $2.565 billion to $2.585 billion
